narrative: On the tables. The tables still open on the four lines. He stands. The stylus stays in the gutter. The bundle is untied by nobody. On the tables. The cover drawn halfway. The four lines still readable. No new word. On the tables. The tables shut. The red bundle alone on its side of the board. The cat has not moved in the time of this look.
